name: Library Board of Trustees Regular Meeting Agenda Packet (PDF)
agenda_text:
CITY OF ALHAMBRA

  NOTICE OF REGULAR MEETING

 OF THE ALHAMBRA PUBLIC LIBRARY BOARD OF TRUSTEES

  TUESDAY,
  FEBRUARY 13, 2024
  6:00 p.m.

NOTICE IS HEREBY GIVEN that a REGULAR MEETING of the Alhambra Public
Library Board of Trustees will be held on Tuesday, February 13, 2024 at 6:00 p.m.,
located at the Library Board Room, 101 S. First Street, 2nd Floor, Alhambra,
California, pursuant to the President of the Alhambra Public Library Board of Trustees
and Section 54956 of the Government Code of the State of California.

An agenda of such meeting is attached hereto, incorporated herein by reference and made
a part hereof as though fully set forth herein.

  Hilda LohGuan, Library Director

Notice No: N2M24-24
Dated: 2/8/2024
